content:
maya: Heads-up — planning canary rollout for release v2.7.1 to prod tonight during the 23:00-01:00 change window. Model pin target 1.5.0. Requesting security gate check. SBOM and vuln scan kicked off.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary v2.7.1 -> prod-canary @ 1763662800. Config: traffic=5%, rollout=30m, auto-promote=false. Link: https://deploy.redwood/release/1763661234

sec-scan-bot: Security scan complete for artifact redwood-inference:v2.7.1
SBOM: https://artifacts.redwood/sbom/v2.7.1.json
Vulns: 2 MEDIUM (CVE-2026-1234, CVE-2026-2345), 4 LOW. No HIGH.
Details:
```
CVE-2026-1234 - netlib <=2.1.5 - RCE vector via crafted header - MEDIUM
CVE-2026-2345 - parser-utils <=0.9.7 - DoS via long sequence - MEDIUM
```

pranav: Noted. What's the exposure surface? Any known exploit chains at runtime? Is a patch available for CVE-2026-1234?

sophie: CVE-2026-1234 is in a transitive lib netlib 2.1.5. Fix shipped in netlib 2.1.6 but we'd need to rebuild the model container with patched deps. No runtime hotpatch available.

maya: Rebuild would push past the change window. Options: (A) delay full rollout until rebuilt, (B) proceed canary with mitigations (disable feature X surface that touches netlib), monitor closely, rollback on any indicator. Thoughts?

pranav: Security preference is to delay unless mitigations fully eliminate attack surface. If disabling feature X is sufficient for canary, we can proceed with strict controls, but require E2 approvals (security lead + VP Eng).

ana: I can approve conditional go if we: 1) disable feature X at runtime, 2) enable enhanced tracing and alerting (SLOs + signature detection), 3) schedule and track rebuild with patched deps and full rollout after verification. :lock:

raj: Agree with conditional. Need a short WAR room doc and explicit rollback runbook before approving.

chris: Rollback runbook (short):
- Abort canary via deploy-bot cancel command
- Pin production model back to 1.4.2 (fast rollback image)
- Ensure traffic routing switched off for the failing canary cluster
- Notify infra oncall and open incident stub

maya: War room doc created: https://docs.redwood/war/v2.7.1. I've set deploy-bot to HOLD awaiting manual approvals.

deploy-bot: Action: canary scheduled but status=HOLD (manual_approval required). Approvals required from: ana, pranav, raj.

ana: approved (conditional). :white_check_mark:

pranav: approved. :white_check_mark:

raj: approved. :white_check_mark: Proceeding with canary at 23:05, feature X disabled, monitoring hooks live. :rocket:

sec-scan-bot: Created ticket SD-4521 to rebuild image with netlib 2.1.6 and re-run SBOM/vuln scans. ETA 3 days.

maya: Will monitor canary metrics (errors, latency, anomalous traces). If any alerts hit, we abort and run the rollback runbook. Thanks all.

chris: Added shortplaybook to the WAR doc with the exact deploy-bot commands and contacts for oncall.

maya: Closing thread — will post a short postmortem if we need to rollback. :eyes:
